purpose: Evaluate frozen 224px and 448px inputs beyond the initial diagnostic examples
selection: First 10 unused multi-candidate prompt groups in pinned metadata order; first 2 videos per group; no annotation or prediction filtering
execution_order: Alternate configuration order by prompt group, score both candidates per configuration
resume: Exclusive process lock; identical manifest, protocol, model, policy and source hashes required; completed jobs are never automatically retried
metrics: non-tied annotation pair agreement; predicted ties incorrect
paired prompt-cluster bootstrap of MAE difference, 5000 resamples, seed 20261022
Per-dimension paired Spearman/Pearson; undefined constant-score correlations reported as null
failure_policy: Preserve every failed or truncated output; report paired coverage and all-input coverage; no successful-only result claim
decision: No parameter tuning or automatic default changes from this evaluation. Report all outcomes and uncertainty. Any later tuning needs a separate split.
scope: 20 videos, 10 prompts; diagnostic subset, not a full benchmark or online experiment
